name: Ashgrave Cathedral
description: Zombies: a gothic cathedral and its precinct at night, on six levels: the grounds and their outbuildings, the nave, transept, choir and chapels, the organ loft and roof walk, the bell tower, the crypt and ossuary, and the dungeons with a smugglers' tunnel. Twenty areas, every perk, a slot machine for every part category, four casino tables, the box in twelve spots. Ring the bell to call the whole horde up the tower.
author: Call of Slop

entities.name: Bell
entities.prompt: ring the bell (the horde climbs the tower: hold the belfry)

entities.name: SiegeText
entities.text: The bell tolls! The horde is climbing the tower: hold the belfry.

entities.name: SiegeWon
entities.text: The siege is broken. The belfry held.
